pages.text: $(thing)Create: Aquatic Ambitions$() ties Minecraft's ocean items to Create. Its centrepiece is the $(item)Conduit Cage$(): a compact conduit you feed with a fluid through its bottom face. A fed cage is $(thing)awakened$().

pages.title: Conduit Cage
pages.text: Awakened with water it gives the Conduit Power effect nearby. Other fluids give other effects.
The cage's mode slot picks who is affected: everyone, players, friendly mobs, players and friendly mobs, or monsters. Its effects are listed in the item's tooltip, so check there.

Awakened cages also work as a $(l:create_basics/fans)fan$(/l) processor. Air blown through one makes a $(thing)Channeling$() stream, and extra water layers dilute it into washing. The classic Conduit ring works the same way.

Channeling can revive dead coral, turn flint into Prismarine Shards, glowstone dust into Prismarine Crystals, an Ender Eye into a Heart of the Sea, and age copper blocks. Look up recipes in JEI under Conduit Channeling.

pages.title: Prismarine Alloy
pages.text: Mixed from Prismarine and Copper Nuggets. Prismarine also smelts into Veridium.

pages.title: Suspicious Rock
pages.text: Wash or channel it for Nautilus Shells, bones and Spiky Shells. Shells crush into bone meal and XP.

Prismarine is also crushable for lapis and Create XP nuggets, so ocean monuments become a source of materials: see $(l:ocean/underwater_places)Underwater Places$(/l). Gravel, Calcium Rich Powder and lava compact into calcite.
